item.description:
WakeBee 0.15.5

Longer closed-lid sessions on a charger and a quieter menu bar.

  • On a charger, closed-lid mode now lasts as long as your session. Choose Unlimited to keep working until you stop, without the previous four-hour cutoff.
  • On battery, choose a time limit up to four hours, including new three-hour and four-hour options. Reconnecting power pauses the battery timer without resetting it.
  • Choose a color or monochrome bee in Settings → General. A green dot continues to indicate an active session.
  • Icon and battery dropdowns now match WakeBee’s glass controls.
  • After a safety stop restores normal sleep settings, the helper requests sleep if the lid is closed.

Battery, temperature, and connection safeguards remain active. End your session and keep the lid open during installation. Versions 0.14 and earlier require a one-time manual migration.

Installation and migration instructions

WakeBee 0.15.4

The menu-bar icon now takes only the space it needs.

  • Removed the empty gap beside the bee when no session is running.
  • The green dot and its space appear when a session starts and disappear when it ends.

End your session and keep the lid open during installation. Versions 0.14 and earlier require a one-time manual migration.

Installation and migration instructions

WakeBee 0.15.3

  • A green dot replaces the menu-bar countdown and On text.
  • Compact, content-sized session panels and smaller Settings. Quit is directly accessible.
  • Closed-lid setup enables the mode after successful macOS approval. Battery use can be configured in one place.
  • Helper registration no longer blocks the UI thread, and idle background work is reduced.

Battery, heat, time, and connection safeguards remain active. End your session and keep the lid open during installation. Versions 0.14 and earlier require a one-time manual migration.

Installation and migration instructions
